QuestInfo.name: They're Coming Back!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra, looking into her Crystal Ball, says they will soon return... But who are 'they'? For details, let's go see #bCassandra#k.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra said you'll find answers if you look into the Crystal Ball.
QuestInfo.2: What you saw in the Crystal Ball was the revival of the Arans. The Arans... Don't you want to know more about them?
